name: Lootable
description: A thing that drops items when it is destroyed or opened. It extends Damageable (by id), so an implementer provides the methods of both traits.

methods.name: loot_table
methods.doc: The name of the loot table to roll when this is looted.

methods.name: roll_loot
methods.doc: Roll the table count times with the given luck bonus; returns how many items dropped.
